jobs.occupation: Associate Professor in ’Oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications’
jobs.description:
The Mads Clausen Institute, Center for Advanced Photovoltaics and Thin-Film Energy Devices (SDU CAPE) invites applications for a tenured Associate Professor position in ‘Oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications’. The starting date is Nov. 1st, 2026, or as soon as possible thereafter. 

What we offer
The Associate Professor position is a part of the SDU CAPE research center, which aims to develop new sustainable photovoltaics and energy technologies using scalable and green processing techniques. This includes activities bridging from synthesis of oxide semiconductors and thin films to their integrate in complete photovoltaic devices, to push the limits of new flexible thin film photovoltaics for the green energy transition. We offer an Associate Professor position within a dynamic research environment that includes students, researchers and research engineers. The position includes both research and teaching responsibilities.

What we expect

Candidates who have a previous PhD degree in a field relevant to the mentioned area may seek the position (physics, chemistry, material science, electrical engineering and similar). You must have a proven strong track record of publications within the areas of e.g. synthesis of oxide semiconductors and thin films, structure-property relationships, PVD processes for oxide thin film fabrication and scale-up, oxide thin films for photovoltaics applications e.g. as transparent conductive oxides, transport layers, active layers, light management layers or barrier layers. The candidate must have documented teaching experience (Assistant Prof. level). The ideal candidate has also documented supervision experience and demonstrated the ability to attract external research funding. Due to the interdisciplinary nature of the work, the candidates are expected to have excellent collaboration skills. A very good capability of communicating scientific results in English, both orally and in writing is required.

The Associate Professor is thus expected to: 

• 
Collaborate with other team members at SDU CAPE and supervise younger researchers

• 
Take responsibility for and lead new research directions within the overall area of oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications

• 
Contribute to establishing new innovation based activities within oxide semiconductors for photovoltaic applications

• 
Be responsible for teaching courses at SDU and supervise BSc, MSc and PhD students

• 
Contribute to obtaining funding for research and innovation projects

• 
Contribute to establishing and maintaining international collaborations

Workplace description / Research environment
We are an international research center working in the field of green energy technologies (CAPE), and we are looking for a highly motivated Associate Professor to join our CAPE research center at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), campus Sønderborg. We offer a modern, inclusive, international and interdisciplinary working environment with state-of-the-art facilities as well as a strong tradition of international collaboration. Our ambition is, to recruit, develop, and retain talented scholars committed to both academic excellence and departmental development.

Having a focus on thin film technologies for energy conversion and storage, the center has full access to a surface science laboratory facility for the fabrication and characterization of thin films and photovoltaic devices, as well as a fully equipped Roll-to-Roll (R2R) facility for upscaling flexible devices. Our research center CAPE is a partner in various national and international research projects and networks that include collaboration partners from both academia and industry. SDU CAPE is also leading the new SDU Climate Cluster (SCC) Elite Center SOLEN, which span across four faculties at SDU to foster, in a cross-disciplinary manner, new thin film solar energy conversion and storage technologies based on green and sustainable solutions.

Read more and apply on: http://www.sdu.dk/en/stillinger

jobs.occupation: Cleaning Assistants, Private Homes – Greater Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Do you enjoy making a difference in people's homes – and finishing the day's last visit with a clear conscience and a great result behind you?

RengøringsAgenterne ApS is looking for several skilled cleaning assistants for our private home cleaning department. You will be out cleaning private homes for our regular customers across Greater Copenhagen – and you will join a team where quality, trust and a good atmosphere come first.

RengøringsAgenterne is a Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified cleaning and property services company based in Kastrup. We have more than 200 employees, run a 100% electric vehicle fleet, and won the Børsen Gazelle award in both 2023 and 2024.

About the job

As a cleaning assistant in private home cleaning, you drive out to our private customers and make sure their homes are sparkling when you leave. You will have regular customers, so you get to know the homes and the customers' wishes – and they get to know you.

Your tasks include:

•      Regular, recurring cleaning of private homes – vacuuming, floor washing, wiping surfaces, bathrooms and kitchens

•      Occasional extra jobs such as deep cleaning and move-out cleaning

•      Driving between customers during the day

•      Everyday dialogue with customers about wishes and arrangements

You work independently in the homes, but you are never on your own – your inspector and the office team are always just a phone call away.

We expect that you

•      Are thorough, reliable in attendance and take pride in a tidy result – quality is what we live on

•      Are trustworthy, as you work in people's private homes and often hold a key to the property

•      Are friendly and service-minded when meeting customers

•      Can make yourself understood in Danish or English

•      Can present a clean criminal record certificate (straffeattest)

•      Enjoy physical work at a good pace

•      Hold a category B driving licence, as you drive between customers during the day

Cleaning experience is an advantage, but not a requirement – we will train you in our methods and Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified products.

We offer

•      A permanent full-time position with a steady monthly income you can count on

•      Working hours on weekdays during the daytime – no evening or weekend work

•      Thorough training, great colleagues and a dedicated inspector you can always turn to

•      Regular customers and routes, so you know your day

•      Work clothing and professional, Nordic Swan Ecolabel certified products and equipment

•      A growing workplace with proper employment terms and green values – our entire vehicle fleet is electric

Practical information

•      Work area: Private homes across Greater Copenhagen – based out of Fuglebækvej 3D, 2770 Kastrup

•      Working hours: Full-time, weekdays during the daytime

•      Start date: As soon as possible, or by agreement

How to apply

Send your application and CV via Jobnet or to privat@ren-agenterne.dk. We hold interviews on an ongoing basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidates – so send your application today.

If you have any questions about the position, feel free to write to us at privat@ren-agenterne.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you!

Do you want to develop advanced automation solutions for critical energy and marine infrastructure?

As a Senior Automation Engineer at Semco Maritime, you will join our Automation & Electrical team, working with complex control systems for energy facilities, marine installations and offshore platforms.

You will take technical ownership of automation solutions throughout the project lifecycle, from functional design and software development to commissioning, troubleshooting and lifecycle support. You will also contribute to the continued development of our technical standards and provide professional guidance to colleagues and project teams.

The role includes opportunities to work with advanced drive and motor-control solutions, including commissioning, troubleshooting and retrofit activities involving Danfoss VLT and VACON products.

At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value. In this role, you will contribute to maintaining and promoting a strong safety culture while delivering reliable and pragmatic solutions for critical installations.

Your place of work will be our Global Headquarters in Esbjerg, located at the heart of the Danish energy industry and directly on the waterfront. The position is full-time, and you can expect approximately 10–30 travel days per year.

Your tasks & responsibilities

You will work across the full project lifecycle in close collaboration with project managers, electrical designers, customers and other technical specialists.

Your main responsibilities will include:

• Taking technical ownership of automation solutions and defining system architecture, interfaces and software structures.
• Designing and developing PLC software, functional descriptions and structured code for complex marine, offshore and energy systems.
• Developing automation solutions for BMS, PMS and hybrid energy systems, including ESS, shore power and generator control.
• Integrating, configuring and commissioning variable-frequency drives and motor and pump-control systems, including various solutions.
• Performing network and system integration across automation, electrical and third-party systems.
• Conducting FAT, SAT and commissioning activities both onshore and offshore.
• Troubleshooting live systems and resolving complex technical issues on critical installations.
• Reviewing and quality-assuring automation designs, software and technical documentation.
• Supporting and mentoring less experienced engineers and contributing to the development of internal standards and best practices.
• Maintaining close technical dialogue with project management, customers, suppliers and other engineering disciplines.

Your profile & qualifications
You have a technical background in automation, electrical engineering or mechatronics and solid experience from the energy, power generation, oil and gas, offshore wind or maritime industries.
You are comfortable working with complex systems where safety, reliability and uptime are essential. You approach your responsibilities proactively, communicate clearly and are capable of taking technical ownership while remaining a strong team player.

We expect that you:

• Have at least five years of experience with PLC programming in Siemens TIA Portal, preferably using SCL.
• Have experience developing automation solutions for energy, marine or offshore applications.
• Have a strong understanding of automation architecture, industrial networks and protocols such as Profinet, Modbus TCP and CAN/J1939.
• Have knowledge of energy systems, power management or hybrid solutions such as ESS and shore power.
• Have experience with variable-frequency drives, motor control and commissioning. Experience with Danfoss VLT or VACON products will be considered an advantage.
• Can translate functional and operational requirements into scalable, structured and well-documented software.
• Are capable of reviewing technical solutions and guiding colleagues on complex automation-related matters.
• Thrive in a project-driven environment with close interdisciplinary collaboration and customer interaction.
• Are willing to participate in commissioning and service assignments both onshore and offshore.
• Are professionally fluent in English. Danish language skills will be considered an advantage.

Your job is to help keep our kitchen clean and running smoothly, so our chefs can focus on creating delicious food and our waiters can focus on welcoming guests with warmth, generosity and care.

Who we are;

We are 2 small and very cozy restaurants in Jægergårdsgade, Århus, Denmark. And we are pleasantly popular and busy. Cheers to the idea that YOU might be one of our new colleagues. We have an ongoing view on all applicants and we welcome new colleagues, when needed. Feel free to send an application to us.

We urge you to go to our SoMe, read about us and see photos of what type of service we do, to get a feel for the atmosphere and the culture we have. Klassisk 65 being the characteristic charming French bistro and Bar´ Habla, our lively and colorful Spanish Bar.

We are a wonderful diverse international team, around 50 colleagues that come from 12-13 different countries, all over the world - Italy, France, Argentina, UK, Bulgaria, Syria, Slovenia, Poland, Nepal, Russia, DK …. Our spoken language is English with a touch of dialect, - charming and very relaxed. 

We are down to earth in mindset and working style, the organization is flat in structure – so there’s no managers to tell you what to do every 10 minutes, thus we expect you to work independently, focused on your tasks and responsibilities and with an eye for the whole team.

We’re looking for someone who:

·       Speaks English, it’s a must! (Danish is a plus)

·       Is responsible, reliable, fast learner and works independently

·       Is able to keep calm, move fast, and keep kitchen clean – also when everything is hectic around you. 

·       Is punctual and dependable

·       Has a positive attitude and can handle physical tasks

·       Preferably has experience in the restaurant/and or cleaning industry

·       Can work either full time or part time, evenings and weekends

We ask of you;

Tattoos, multi-colored trousers, straight hair, no hair, A, B, C, D chest seize, flip beard, mustacho or too much beard…..  We don’t really mind - as long as you have a big smile, are clean, outgoing, service minded, a good helpful colleague, willing to learn new stuff and can move fast in our kitchen. Please understand, our team are hardworking people, if you have an addiction problem with drugs, alcohol etc. - you do not need to apply to any of the positions! Its one of our non-negotiables and a key company values.

Acknowledging the importance in complying with company rules and guidelines, eg. for best practice in ´cleaning & hygiene´ – is another key factor in our company.

We offer;

·       A lively and nice place to work, no days are alike

·       Salary linked to qualifications (all staff are hourly paid and have development plans)

·       We teach you, the first 3-5 shifts are trial shifts - and you get paid for these too

·       An opportunity to expand your competencies  

·       Staff food when working

·       50% discount on your bill for 4 pax, if you eat in the restaurants on certain days

·       Staff trips and staff events over the year – e.g. Ice skating, Tivoli event

International students that only can work 10-15 hours/week are also welcome. 

Please, only apply for the job, if you live close by and are able to come to work and stay until your shift ends at night/after midnight. Its non-negotiable.

Please note, getting a job in one of our places is subject to a valid Danish work permit and Danish bank account. So you must be able to get a CPR number (personal identification number ) and a work permit in Denmark.

Please send an e-mail to info@jobsaka.dk with your; application - photo, - and please inform us about where in the process your are, regarding obtaining a Danish work permit.

Header in e-mail MUST clearly state; the job role Dishwasher & if you seek parttime or full time. 

If your header is not displaying this, your applications will not be taken into account, thanks.

Are you a trained mechanic, and are you motivated by technology, quality and good colleagues? Would you like to become part of a modern, fully electric vehicle workshop where professional development, teamwork and fleet operational stability are the focus? Then you might be the person we're looking for at our workshop at GreenMobility in Rødovre!

Professionalism, quality and development

At GreenMobility, we are looking for a skilled senior technician/automechanic who, together with the rest of the workshop team, will ensure high quality in the daily work and contribute to the best possible operational stability for our fleet of 1,400 electric cars in Copenhagen.

You will become part of a professional workshop where we work exclusively with electric vehicles, modern technology and ongoing skills development. If you are earlier in your career, we will provide thorough training and sparring from experienced colleagues.

Your primary tasks will include:

• 
Maintenance and repair of passenger cars (fully electric), including motors, gearboxes, brakes, suspension and coupling systems

• 
Fault-finding and diagnosis of error codes using OEM and third-party diagnostic tools

• 
Identifying and repairing faults on electric motors

• 
Servicing and repairing AC pumps and climate systems

• 
Carrying out routine inspections and preventive maintenance to minimise fleet downtime

• 
Accurate documentation of all repairs, parts used and diagnostic results in the workshop system

We imagine that you:

• 
Are a trained passenger car mechanic or have an equivalent technical background

• 
Work independently, in a structured and quality-conscious manner

• 
Have an interest in new technology, modern vehicle systems and electric cars

• 
Are a team player who contributes positively to collaboration in the workshop

• 
Focus on delivering high quality and doing the job right the first time

• 
Hold a category B driving licence

• 
Have English skills sufficient for technical documentation and team communication

• 
Are comfortable using digital tools to document repairs across the fleet

Experience with our vehicle brands (Renault, Kia, Nissan...) is an advantage, but not a requirement. What matters most is your professional curiosity and desire to develop.

Your new workplace

GreenMobility is the largest free-floating car-sharing operator in the Nordics. With a fleet of 1,600 electric cars, we contribute to greener and cleaner mobility in Aarhus and Copenhagen. Every month we enable more than 185,000 shared car trips, reducing car ownership and making cities more liveable places.

We offer

• 
To be part of a green mission you can be proud of

• 
An exciting everyday working life in a modern workshop

• 
Ongoing training and good development opportunities

• 
A strong professional and international working environment with skilled colleagues

• 
Attractive terms of employment

• 
A workplace focused on wellbeing, collaboration and integrity

Would you like to join the team? We look forward to receiving your application.

We review applications on an ongoing basis and will hire once we have found the right candidate, so please send your application as soon as possible.

If you have questions about the position, you are very welcome to contact Fanny Dutrey on +45 31 27 21 30 or fd@greenmobility.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

GreenMobility A/S

Are you a relationship builder with a passion for driving growth? Management Events is seeking Key Client Managers and Network Growth Managers to join our team. You will play a pivotal role in expanding our network of high-level decision-makers. How do these roles contribute to the company's growth?

As a Key Client Manager, you will focus on building and maintaining strong relationships with existing C-suite clients.

As a Network Growth Manager, you will identify and cultivate new relationships with C-suite executives.

In this role, you will:

    Identify and engage with high-level decision-makers in your target market market
    Initiate contact with C-level Executives by phone and on LinkedIn to excite them about our concept
    Demonstrate the value of our service and convince them to become part of our exclusive business network in personal scheduled videocall meetings
    Build strong, long-term relationships with C-level executives
    Learn more about their interests, investments plans and upcoming projects
    Develop and execute strategies to expand our network and build valuable relationships, by knowing your customers key challenges and focus areas
    Contribute to the overall growth and success of Management Events

What We’re Looking For

    1–2 years of client-facing experience in a commercial or B2B environment
    Previous experience with cold calling and building business relationships
    Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
    Strong business acumen and a results-oriented mindset
    Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, target-driven environment
    Passion for connecting with key industry players and driving business growth
    Proactive and persistent approach to reaching new clients and overcoming challenges
    Fluency in Danish and English

What We Offer

    Performance rewarded: You’ll receive an attractive compensation package with base salary, commission, and an additional starter bonus to support you as you ramp up and build your sales pipeline.
    Growth and learning: From day one, you’ll benefit from a four-week onboarding program and continuous coaching through our international ME Academy, ensuring you’re always developing and moving forward in your career.
    Career opportunities across Europe: As we continue to grow, you’ll have the chance to explore international opportunities. With offices in Helsinki, Amsterdam, Antwerp, Copenhagen, Berlin, Stockholm, Kuala Lumpur, and Barcelona, your career can take you anywhere.
    Recharge & Thrive: We care about your well-being and want you to stay energized both inside and outside of work. That’s why you can earn up to 12 extra vacation days each year and enjoy local perks such as gym and massage discounts, along with other wellness benefits. Curious about the details in your location? Ask your recruiter to learn more.
    We win together: Collaboration is our driving force, and every success is shared. That’s why we love bringing people together through company trips, international events, and local office celebrations — whether it’s hitting the slopes in Levi, running the Berlin Marathon together, or celebrating milestones across our offices in Europe.
    Annual company trip: Every summer, all employees from our different offices come together in Finland for an exciting company trip - a mix of team building, knowledge exchange, and celebrations.
    Global Community & Diversity: Diversity is part of our DNA. With colleagues from over 50 nationalities, you’ll join an international community where every culture, perspective, and background fuels innovation and success.

Recruitment Process

    Screening video call with our Recruitment Team.
    First interview with the Hiring Manager.
    Second interview (including a short role-play) with the Team Manager.
    Reference check and/or short personal assessment

Please submit your CV in English.
